title: run_freq belongs to Operator / Group, not qt.run
summary: Backtest frequency is an Operator/Group field. Passing freq into qt.run or QT_CONFIG fails.
narrative:
run_freq and run_timing live on Group (and Operator accepts run_freq at construction). Strategy objects do not cache their own frequency; they read it from the owning Group.

Do not pass freq / run_freq as a qt.run() keyword or as a QT_CONFIG built-in key. That raises: config_key is not a built-in parameter key.

Spoken 'daily backtest' should become Operator(..., run_freq='d'), not a run() config patch.
python_code:
import qteasy as qt
op = qt.Operator(strategies=['macd'], run_freq='d')
# Wrong: qt.run(op, freq='d')  # freq is not a qt.run / QT_CONFIG key
qt.run(op, mode=1, asset_pool='000300.SH', invest_start='20180101', invest_end='20231231')
risk_notes: Mis-routing freq into qt.run is a known qteasy-ai skill trap; Ask only explains, it does not call qt.run.
